tools.name: start_bobby_setup
tools.description: Use this when a user is new, asks how to connect Bobby or Robinhood, or wants personalized portfolio help. Shows a single in-chat setup path and one-tap prompts. Ask profile questions one at a time in the conversation; do not send the user to a multi-page guide or request credentials.

tools.name: get_free_stock_brief
tools.description: Use this when the user asks about one explicit US-listed stock or ETF. Returns a cached public quote, recent price chart, current precomputed evidence, risk framing, and contextual next questions. It does not call a paid AI model, access a portfolio, or make a personalized recommendation.

tools.name: compare_two_stocks_free
tools.description: Use this when the user names exactly two US-listed stocks or ETFs and wants a compact evidence comparison. Returns cached public price action and already-computed Bobby context. It does not choose a winner, inspect a portfolio, or execute a trade.

tools.name: get_free_market_pulse
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what is moving the broad US market or whether the current tape is risk-on, risk-off, or mixed. Returns Bobby’s latest already-computed public market regime; it does not expose paid alerts or portfolio data.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "start_bobby_setup" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
